'''Bastian Winkelhaus Epic Hunt Down''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds71.htm Epic Hunt Down], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055617/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds71.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
